zh.subtitle: 本地记录垃圾与营销账号。计数只在你确认之后增加。
zh.protectFollowing: 你关注了这个账号。不会因关键词/黄标自动入队；你手动记满阈值后仍可静音或屏蔽。
zh.protectWhitelist: 这个账号在白名单里。静音和屏蔽不会自动入队。
zh.protectBoth: 你关注了这个账号，并且它在白名单里。白名单不会自动入队静音或屏蔽。仅关注时，你手动记满阈值后仍可静音或屏蔽。
zh.chipOpen: 打开标记。这一下不会记一笔，也不会静音或屏蔽。
zh.chipMore: 还有 {count} 个标签。点开标记。
zh.hiddenOn: 时间线上不再展开此人的帖子
zh.no-handle: 这条帖子没有可读的用户名
zh.skipWhitelist: @{handle} 在白名单里，已达阈值也不会自动处理
zh.skipFollowing: @{handle} 是你关注的账号。不会因关键词/黄标自动入队；你手动记满阈值后仍可静音或屏蔽。
zh.promptOnly: @{handle} 的{tag}已到 {count}/{n}。当前是仅提示，没有折叠或静音。
zh.platformOff: 原生静音/屏蔽还没打开。本地折叠仍然可用。
zh.ruleBody: 「{pack}」命中这条帖子。记为{tag}会计一次，取消则只保持黄标。
zh.thresholdBody: @{handle} 的{tag}已有 {count} 次（阈值 {n}）。本地折叠只影响这台浏览器里的时间线。
zh.thresholdWarnFollow: 你正在关注这个账号。不会因关键词/黄标自动入队；你已经手动记满阈值，可以按当前模式静音或屏蔽。
zh.thresholdWarnUnknown: 页面上没看到关注状态。自动静音和屏蔽不会执行。
zh.muteHint: 先进入队列，再点 X 自己的「更多」菜单。间隔至少 1 秒，并另加约 1–2.5 秒抖动。
zh.blockHint: 会再点一次 X 的确认框。失败留在队列里重试，并受每日上限约束。
zh.aiNone: AI 认为不像垃圾或营销
zh.bad-ai-response: AI 没有返回可识别的 spam / marketing / none
zh.actionOk: 已通过 X 的菜单尝试{action} @{handle}
zh.daily-cap: 今天的静音/屏蔽次数已到上限
zh.rateLimited: 页面上出现限流提示，队列会退避后再试。
zh.queuedConfirm: 已处理 @{handle}。静音/屏蔽在队列里，不会连点。
zh.searchPh: 搜索用户名、显示名或标签
zh.emptyLedger: 账本还是空的。到时间线上点「标记」。
zh.error: 扩展暂时没有响应，请在 chrome://extensions 里重新加载。
zh.modeHelpAuto: 自动本地折叠（已关注的账号不会因此被折叠）。静音和屏蔽还要打开下面的开关。白名单不会自动入队；已关注在你手动记满阈值后仍会入队。关注状态未知时不会自动静音或屏蔽。
zh.modeHelpConfirm: 弹出确认。默认只勾选本地折叠。
zh.modeHelpPrompt: 只显示一条提示，不折叠、不静音、不屏蔽。
zh.hideOn: 达到阈值时包含本地折叠
zh.platformOn: 允许通过 X 的菜单执行静音/屏蔽
zh.platformRisk: 这项会替你点击 X 的原生菜单，可能违反 X 的条款，也可能因为页面改版而失败。默认关闭。不会调用未公开的 GraphQL。
zh.rateLabel: 两次菜单操作的最少间隔（毫秒，至少 1000）。队列还会再加 1–2.5 秒抖动。
zh.queueHelp: 静音和屏蔽先进入这条队列，再由打开的时间线逐条点击 X 自己的菜单。间隔不少于你设的最小值，并额外加约 1–2.5 秒抖动；有每日上限。页面上若出现能识别的限流提示（例如 429）会退避。白名单不会自动入队。已关注账号不会因关键词或黄标自动入队；你手动记满阈值后仍按自动/确认/仅提示处理。关注状态未知时也不会自动静音或屏蔽。仅提示模式不会入队。暂停是手动开关，退避时间未到之前不会继续点。
zh.backoffUntil: 限流退避到 {time} 再继续
zh.pausedHint: 队列已暂停，不会点击 X 的菜单。
zh.confirmClearQueue: 清空等待中和进行中的静音/屏蔽？失败项会保留。
zh.libraryLinkHelp: 作者标记存在本账本（xsl 的 ledger[用户].authorFlags），书签库读同一份。显示「常营销 / 常垃圾」不会删除书签，也不会因此静音或屏蔽。白名单仍不会自动入队；已关注仍是软保护。
zh.libraryChipFromStrikes: 打击次数达到下面的次数时，在书签里显示常营销 / 常垃圾
zh.libraryChipThreshold: 书签芯片阈值（与静音/屏蔽阈值分开）
zh.bookmarkMarkAddsStrike: 在书签里标作者时，同时给账本记一笔
zh.bookmarkMarkAddsStrikeHelp: 默认关闭：只在书签上显示芯片，不增加打击次数，也不进入静音/屏蔽队列。打开后，每个作者最多用一条书签作为依据记一笔，仍然不会自动静音或屏蔽。
zh.libraryFlagToggle: 同时在书签库标出这个作者
zh.libraryFlagHint: 勾选后，这次记的垃圾或营销会写到作者身上。未达次数时，已有和以后同步的书签也会显示芯片。不会静音或屏蔽。
zh.localOnly: 数据只在这个浏览器配置里，存在 chrome.storage.local。
zh.grant: 启用 AI 时浏览器会询问对网站的访问权限，用来调用你填写的端点。
zh.grantDenied: 没有授予网络权限，保存了设置，但请求会失败。
zh.autoSuggest: 只对黄标可疑帖自动询问（仍然不会自动记账）
zh.aiDistillHint: AI 若建议垃圾或营销，点时间线上的建议芯片，确认后可把抽出的短词存进一个词库。只出黄标，不会自动记一笔，也不会因此再请求模型。
zh.distillNote: 这些短词来自这一条建议，并且出现在帖子里。写入词库后只出黄标，不会记一笔。
zh.distillAdded: 已把 {count} 条加入「{pack}」。没有记一笔。
zh.distillDuplicate: 这些词已经在「{pack}」里。没有记一笔。
zh.distillPartial: 已加入 {count} 条到「{pack}」，{dup} 条原本就在。没有记一笔。
zh.ruleEnqueueHelp: 每一条规则默认可以参与入队。取消「可入队」之后，这条规则仍然会匹配：黄标还在，该折叠的仍然折叠。关掉入队不是关掉匹配，也不是停用这条规则。只是仅因这条规则产生的命中，不会把账号推进静音或屏蔽队列。同一条帖子上若还有别的「可入队」规则一起命中，并且打击次数记满阈值，仍按全局的自动、确认或仅提示入队。白名单和已关注的保护不变。社区名单命中仍然不记账、不入队。「本包可入队」一次改这个包里的每一条。
zh.ruleNoQueue: 这次命中的规则关掉了入队。黄标和折叠不受影响，但不会因此静音或屏蔽。其它仍可入队的规则记满阈值后，仍按原来的方式入队。
zh.commentScanHelp: 和时间线的关键词预标分开，默认关闭。只作用于推文详情页里、主帖以外的回复。内容脚本本来就会注入详情页，这里不另走 GraphQL。打开后，回复沿用现有关键词包：命中出黄色「可疑」，点它可以确认记一笔。默认只折叠这一条回复，也可以改成只提示。评论命中不会自动静音或屏蔽。白名单不折叠。已关注的账号不自动折叠，也不自动入队。排队仍只走标记面板里的 X 菜单。
zh.commentModeFoldHelp: 只藏这一条，不给账号记一笔，也不静音或屏蔽。点折叠条或「展开这条」可以看原文，再点收起。也可以点黄标确认记一笔。
zh.commentModePromptHelp: 不折叠。黄标和「标记」留在回复上。点黄标才会问你要不要记一笔。
zh.commentFolded: 折叠了 @{handle} 的这条回复
zh.commentFoldMeta: 关键词命中。没有记一笔，也没有静音或屏蔽。
zh.commentNoQueue: 评论区的关键词或黄标不会自动静音或屏蔽。要入队请在标记里点排队，仍由时间线去点 X 的菜单。
zh.commentSuspectTitle: 确认给这个账号记一笔。不会自动静音或屏蔽。
zh.foldReasonHelp: 默认打开。时间线上本地折叠的帖子，以及评论区折叠的回复，都会在折叠条上写出命中的词，或已有的「AI 建议垃圾」说法。好几条命中时只留最主要的一条，其余收成 +N；太长的正则收成「词库 +N」，避免占满一行。点折叠条展开原文，再点收起。关掉后仍然折叠，只是不写原因。不改变记账、静音、屏蔽、白名单或已关注。
zh.communityHelp: 可选，默认关闭。导入或订阅之后，勾选「启用社区名单」并保存，命中才会出黄色「可疑」。可以只出黄标，或允许按现有折叠策略折叠：白名单不折叠，已关注不折叠，你正在看的那条主帖不折叠。社区名单命中不记一笔，不进入静音或屏蔽队列；点黄标也只说明名单名称，不记账。名单留在本机。订阅失败时继续用上次成功的缓存。
zh.communityModeYellowHelp: 只显示黄色「可疑」。不折叠，不记账，不静音，不屏蔽。
zh.communityModeFoldHelp: 收起这条时间线帖子或回复。白名单不折叠。已关注不折叠。详情页正在看的主帖不折叠。不会记一笔，也不会静音或屏蔽。
zh.communityImportHelp: 稳定格式是上面的 JSON。文本也可以：一行一条，@ 开头是账号，其余是正文里的原词（不是正则），# name: 写名称。导入只写入本机，不会把开关打开。
zh.communityUrlHelp: 只接受 https，或本机 http://localhost / 127.0.0.1。刷新是手动的，可以删除订阅。拉取失败时保留上次缓存，并在卡片上显示错误。不会把账本同步到云端。
zh.communityDeleteConfirm: 删除「{name}」？只移走这台设备上的副本。
zh.communityCached: 刷新失败，仍用上次缓存
zh.communityNoStrike: 社区名单命中不记账，也不会静音或屏蔽。
zh.communityFoldMeta: 社区名单命中。没有记一笔，也没有静音或屏蔽。
zh.communityImported: 已导入「{name}」。开关仍是关的，要启用请勾选后保存。
zh.communitySubscribed: 已订阅「{name}」。开关仍是关的，要启用请勾选后保存。
zh.communityKept: 刷新失败，仍用上次缓存。
zh.communityFetchNew: 没有拉下来，名单未添加。
zh.bad-url: 只接受 https 链接，或本机 http://localhost / 127.0.0.1
zh.fetch-failed: 没有拉下来。已有缓存保持不变。
zh.timeout: 拉取超时。已有缓存保持不变。
zh.not-url: 这不是一条 URL 订阅
zh.communityHttp: 拉取失败（HTTP {status}）。已有缓存保持不变。
zh.emptyLog: 还没有折叠或菜单动作
zh.fileBad: 这个 JSON 无法读取
zh.openTimeline: 去 x.com 的时间线使用标记按钮。已关注的账号在名字下显示「已关注保护」：不会因关键词/黄标自动入队，你手动记满阈值后仍可静音或屏蔽。仅白名单显示「白名单保护」，不会自动入队。已有标签显示成「垃圾×2」这样的芯片，点一下打开标记。
zh.riskTitle: 静音和屏蔽不是默认动作
zh.examples: 示例词库覆盖中英文引流、诈骗话术、短链和联系方式。黄标不会增加计数。
zh.addFromTweet: 在帖子里选中一个词，点「标记」，选一个词库再点「加入此包」。也可以在 x.com 上右键选中的文字，选「把选中文字加入关键词包」。两种方式都只加关键词，不记一笔。
zh.addKeywordNote: 只把这个词加入词库。之后命中会出黄标，不会自动记一笔。
zh.keyword-plain: 请选择包含文字或数字的词
zh.packTextHelp: 可直接改这段文本。点「应用文本」会替换表单里的词库，再点保存才写入。没有 [包名] 的纯文本会变成一个名为 Imported 的包。命中只出黄标。整包写 enqueue: false，或在某一行末尾写 {enqueue:false}，表示这条不入队；匹配、黄标和折叠仍在。
zh.packTextApplied: 已从文本读入 {count} 个词库。点保存后生效。
zh.hitHistoryHelp: 打开后，时间线上的黄标会留下最多 40 条短记录（词、包、账号、摘要）。只存在本机，不会增加打击次数。
zh.shortcutNote: 快捷键看物理按键，在 x.com 上、光标位于帖子附近、且没有在输入框里时生效。
zh.fpBody: 将在这台浏览器里停用下面的命中。已经确认的记一笔不会撤销，也不会静音或屏蔽。
zh.fpCooldown: 冷却 {days} 天：这些词单独再出现时不再标黄。若同时命中另一条未停用的规则，仍会标黄。
zh.fpForever: 这些词会一直停用，直到你在设置里撤销。
zh.fpExceptionHelp: 含有该短语时，上面这些词不再标黄。只存在本机，不写入词库，也不记一笔。例外一直有效，直到你撤销。
zh.fpScopeAny: 任何作者出现该短语都跳过这些词
zh.fpSaved: 已停用 {count} 条命中。已确认的记录还在，也没有静音或屏蔽。
zh.fpSavedPhrase: 已停用 {count} 条命中，并记下例外「{phrase}」。已确认的记录还在，也没有静音或屏蔽。
zh.fpSavedAi: 这条建议已记为不像。已确认的记录还在，也没有静音或屏蔽。
zh.fpCooled: 冷却中，因另一条规则仍标黄
zh.vetoHelp: 在黄标或 AI 建议里点「不像」之后，命中的词记在这里。撤销只恢复这条词，不会改已确认的打击次数，也不会静音或屏蔽。白名单仍是硬保护，已关注仍是软保护。
zh.vetoCooldownDays: 冷却天数（0 表示一直停用，直到撤销）
zh.vetoCooldownHelp: 大于 0 时，这些词在这么多天内单独命中不再标黄；若同时命中另一条未停用规则，仍会标黄。到期后这个词恢复。例外短语不跟着到期，直到你撤销那一条。
zh.vetoUndone: 已撤销这条停用。已确认的记录没有改动。

en.subtitle: A local ledger for spam and marketing accounts. Counts move only after you confirm.
en.protectFollowing: You follow this account. Keyword hits and the yellow Suspect chip do not auto-queue mute or block. After you confirm enough strikes to reach your threshold, mute or block can still be queued.
en.protectWhitelist: This account is whitelisted. Mute and block are never auto-queued.
en.protectBoth: You follow this account and it is whitelisted. The whitelist never auto-queues mute or block. Following alone still allows mute or block after you confirm enough strikes.
en.chipOpen: Open the mark sheet. This does not add a strike, mute, or block.
en.chipMore: {count} more tags. Open the mark sheet.
en.hiddenOn: Their posts stay collapsed on this timeline
en.no-handle: This post has no readable handle
en.no-tweet: This post has no usable id
en.skipWhitelist: @{handle} is whitelisted, so the threshold does nothing automatic
en.skipFollowing: @{handle} is an account you follow. Keyword hits and the yellow chip do not auto-queue mute or block. After you confirm enough strikes, mute or block can still be queued.
en.promptOnly: @{handle} reached {count}/{n} for {tag}. Prompt-only mode does not hide or mute.
en.platformOff: Native mute/block is off. Local hide still works.
en.ruleBody: “{pack}” matched this post. Marking it {tag} adds a strike. Cancel leaves the yellow chip.
en.thresholdBody: @{handle} has {count} {tag} strikes (threshold {n}). Local hide only affects this browser.
en.thresholdWarnFollow: You follow this account. Keyword hits and the yellow chip do not auto-queue mute or block. You confirmed enough strikes, so mute or block follows the current mode.
en.thresholdWarnUnknown: The page did not show whether you follow them. Mute and block will not run automatically.
en.muteHint: Joins the queue, then clicks X's own More menu. The gap is at least 1s plus about 1–2.5s of jitter.
en.blockHint: Also clicks X's confirm sheet. Failures stay queued for retry, under the daily cap.
en.aiNone: AI does not see spam or marketing
en.bad-ai-response: The model did not return spam, marketing, or none
en.rateLimited: The page showed a rate-limit notice. The queue will back off, then retry.
en.queuedConfirm: Applied @{handle}. Mute/block is queued and will not fire in a burst.
en.no-item: That menu item was not found
en.emptyLedger: The ledger is empty. Use Mark on the timeline.
en.error: The extension did not answer. Reload it at chrome://extensions.
en.modeHelpAuto: Hides locally, except accounts you follow. Mute and block also need the switches below. A whitelist is never auto-queued. An account you follow is still queued after you confirm enough strikes. Unknown follow state does not auto-mute or auto-block.
en.modeHelpConfirm: Asks first. Local hide is the only box checked by default.
en.modeHelpPrompt: Shows a notice only. No hide, mute, or block.
en.hideOn: Include local hide at the threshold
en.platformOn: Allow mute/block through X's own menu
en.platformRisk: This clicks X's native menu for you. It can conflict with X's terms and can break when the site changes. Off by default. It does not call private GraphQL.
en.rateLabel: Minimum gap between menu actions (ms, at least 1000). The queue adds another 1–2.5s of jitter.
en.includeSecrets: Include the API key in the export
en.queueHelp: Mute and block wait here. An open timeline tab then clicks X's own menu one account at a time. The gap is your minimum plus about 1–2.5s of jitter, with a daily cap. A recognizable rate-limit notice (such as 429) backs off. Whitelist accounts are never auto-queued. Accounts you follow are not auto-queued from a keyword hit or the yellow chip; after you confirm enough strikes, the current mode (automatic / confirm / prompt-only) still applies. Unknown follow state does not auto-mute or auto-block. Prompt-only mode does not enqueue. Pause is a manual switch; backoff still waits out its timer.
en.pausedHint: The queue is paused, so it will not click X's menu.
en.confirmClearQueue: Clear pending and in-progress mute/block items? Failed items stay.
en.libraryLinkHelp: Author flags live in this ledger (xsl, ledger[user].authorFlags). The bookmark library reads that same record. A marketing-prone or spam-prone chip does not delete bookmarks and does not mute or block. Whitelist stays a hard protect. Following stays a soft protect.
en.libraryChipFromStrikes: Show a library chip once strike counts reach the number below
en.bookmarkMarkAddsStrike: Marking an author in the library also adds one strike
en.bookmarkMarkAddsStrikeHelp: Off by default: the library chip appears and the strike count stays unchanged, with nothing queued. On: at most one bookmark per author is recorded as evidence. Mute and block are still not queued from this.
en.libraryFlagToggle: Also flag this author in the bookmark library
en.libraryFlagHint: When checked, this spam or marketing mark is stored on the author, so current and future bookmarks show the chip even below the count. It does not mute or block.
en.localOnly: Data stays in this browser profile, in chrome.storage.local.
en.grant: Turning AI on asks Chrome for site access so it can call the endpoint you typed.
en.grantDenied: Site access was denied. Settings were saved, but requests will fail.
en.autoSuggest: Ask automatically for yellow suspects only (still never an automatic strike)
en.aiDistillHint: If AI suggests spam or marketing, open that chip on the timeline and confirm Save as keyword/rule. The words go into one pack, only paint the yellow chip, and do not add a strike or call the model again.
en.distillNote: These short rules were distilled from this suggestion and occur in the post. Saving them only paints the yellow chip. It does not add a strike.
en.distillAdded: Added {count} to “{pack}”. No strike was added.
en.distillDuplicate: Those rules are already in “{pack}”. No strike was added.
en.distillPartial: Added {count} to “{pack}”; {dup} were already there. No strike was added.
en.ruleEnqueueHelp: Each rule can queue by default. Uncheck Can queue and that rule still matches: the yellow chip stays, and folding still happens when the other settings allow it. Turning queueing off is not turning matching off, and it does not disable the rule. A hit that comes only from that rule does not push the account into the mute or block queue. If another rule that can still queue also hits, and the strike count reaches the threshold, mute and block still follow automatic, confirm, or prompt-only. Whitelist and following protections stay as they are. Community-list hits still never record a strike and never queue. This pack can queue sets every rule in the pack.
en.ruleNoQueue: The rule that hit has queueing turned off. The yellow chip and folding are unchanged, but this hit does not mute or block. Other rules that can still queue follow the usual path once the threshold is met.
en.commentScanHelp: Separate from timeline keyword pre-flags, and off by default. It only applies to replies on a tweet detail page, not the focal post. The content script already runs on status pages; this does not call GraphQL. When on, replies use the same keyword packs: a hit paints the yellow Suspect chip, and you can confirm a strike from that chip. The default folds that one reply; you can switch to prompt only. A comment hit never auto-mutes or auto-blocks. Whitelist is not folded. Accounts you follow are not auto-folded and are not auto-queued. Mute and block still queue only from the Mark sheet, through X’s own menu.
en.commentModeFoldHelp: Hides that one reply. It does not add a strike, mute, or block. Click the bar or Show this post to read it, then click again to collapse it. The yellow chip can still confirm a strike.
en.commentModePrompt: Yellow chip only, until you confirm
en.commentModePromptHelp: Does not fold. The chip and Mark stay on the reply. A strike is added only if you confirm the chip.
en.commentFoldMeta: Keyword hit. No strike, mute, or block.
en.commentNoQueue: A comment keyword or yellow chip does not auto-mute or auto-block. Queue from Mark if you want that; the timeline still clicks X’s own menu.
en.commentSuspectTitle: Confirm a strike for this account. This does not mute or block.
en.foldReason: Show why on the collapse bar
en.foldReasonHelp: On by default. A locally collapsed timeline post and a folded reply name the matched word, or the existing “AI suggests Spam” label. Several hits keep the main one and fold the rest into +N. A long regex becomes “Pack +N” so it does not fill the row. Click the bar to show the post, and click again to collapse it. Turning this off still folds, without the reason. It does not change strikes, mute, block, whitelist, or following.
en.communityHelp: Optional, and off until you turn it on. After you import or subscribe, check Enable community lists and save. A hit paints the yellow Suspect chip. Yellow only leaves the post open. Allow folding uses the same protections as other folds: whitelist is not folded, accounts you follow are not folded, and the status tweet you opened stays open. A community-list hit never adds a strike and never enters the mute or block queue. Clicking the yellow chip does not add a strike either. The copy stays on this device. If a refresh fails, the last successful copy is kept.
en.communityModeYellowHelp: Shows the yellow Suspect chip. It does not fold, add a strike, mute, or block.
en.communityModeFoldHelp: Collapses that timeline post or reply. Whitelist is not folded. Accounts you follow are not folded. The open status tweet is not folded. No strike, mute, or block.
en.communityImportHelp: The stable format is the JSON above. Plain text works too: one entry per line, @handle is an account, any other line is a literal word (not a regex), and # name: sets the title. Importing writes this device only and does not turn the switch on.
en.communityUrlHelp: https only, or http://localhost / 127.0.0.1 on this machine. Refresh is manual, and you can delete a subscription. A failed fetch keeps the last cached copy and shows the error on that card. This does not sync the ledger to a cloud.
en.communityDeleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This only removes the copy on this device.
en.communityCached: Refresh failed. Still using the last cached copy
en.communityNoStrike: A community-list hit does not add a strike, mute, or block.
en.communityFoldMeta: Community list. No strike, mute, or block.
en.communityImported: Imported “{name}”. The switch is still off. Check it and save to enable.
en.communitySubscribed: Subscribed to “{name}”. The switch is still off. Check it and save to enable.
en.communityKept: Refresh failed. The last cached copy is still in use.
en.communityFetchNew: The list could not be downloaded, so nothing was added.
en.bad-url: Use an https link, or http://localhost / 127.0.0.1
en.fetch-failed: Download failed. A cached copy is unchanged.
en.timeout: The download timed out. A cached copy is unchanged.
en.list-full: The list limit has been reached
en.not-url: That entry is not a URL subscription
en.no-list: That list is not on this device
en.communityHttp: Download failed (HTTP {status}). A cached copy is unchanged.
en.emptyLog: No hide or menu actions yet
en.fileBad: This JSON could not be read
en.confirmDelete: Remove @{handle} from the ledger? You can undo it.
en.openTimeline: Open an x.com timeline and use Mark. Accounts you follow show a Protected badge (已关注保护): keyword hits and the yellow chip do not auto-queue mute or block, but mute or block can still be queued after you confirm enough strikes. Whitelist-only accounts show the same English badge (白名单保护) and are never auto-queued. Existing tags appear as chips such as Spam×2. Click a chip to open Mark.
en.riskTitle: Mute and block are not the default
en.examples: Example packs cover Chinese and English spam, marketing, short links, and contact drops. A yellow chip does not add a strike.
en.addFromTweet: Select a word in a post, click Mark, pick a pack, then Add to this pack. Or right-click the selection on x.com and choose Add selection to keyword pack. Neither path adds a strike.
en.addKeywordNote: This only adds a keyword. Later hits show a yellow Suspect chip and do not add a strike.
en.keywordAdded: Added “{word}” to “{pack}”. No strike was added.
en.empty-keyword: There is no word to add
en.keyword-long: That word is longer than 80 characters
en.keyword-plain: Choose a word that contains a letter or number
en.no-pack: That keyword pack was not found
en.packTextHelp: Edit this text, then Apply text to replace the packs in the form. Save to keep them. A file with no [pack] header becomes one pack named Imported. A hit only shows the yellow chip. enqueue: false on a pack, or {enqueue:false} at the end of a line, turns queueing off for that rule. Matching, the yellow chip, and folding stay on.
en.packTextApplied: Loaded {count} packs from text. Save to keep them.
en.hitHistoryHelp: When on, yellow chips leave up to 40 short local rows (word, pack, account, snippet). This never adds a strike.
en.shortcutNote: Shortcuts use the physical key on x.com when a post is under the pointer or focused, and you are not typing in a field.
en.fpBody: These hits will be turned off on this browser. Confirmed strikes stay. Nothing is muted or blocked.
en.fpCooldown: Cool-down {days} days: these words alone will not paint the yellow chip. They can still show if another rule that is not cooled down also matches.
en.fpForever: These words stay off until you undo the veto in settings.
en.fpExceptionHelp: When the phrase is present, those words do not paint the yellow chip. Stored only on this browser. It is not added to a pack and does not add a strike. The exception lasts until you undo it.
en.fpScopeAny: Skip those words for any author when the phrase appears
en.fpSaved: Turned off {count} hits. Confirmed strikes were left as they are, and nothing was muted or blocked.
en.fpSavedPhrase: Turned off {count} hits and saved the exception “{phrase}”. Confirmed strikes were left as they are, and nothing was muted or blocked.
en.fpSavedAi: This suggestion was saved as not spam. Confirmed strikes were left as they are, and nothing was muted or blocked.
en.fpCooled: cooled down; still yellow because another rule matched
en.vetoHelp: After you choose Not spam on a yellow chip or an AI suggestion, the matched words are listed here. Undoing one restores that word only. It does not change confirmed strikes, and it does not mute or block. Whitelist stays a hard protect. Following stays a soft protect.
en.vetoCooldownDays: Cool-down days (0 = stay off until undo)
en.vetoCooldownHelp: Above 0, those words alone do not paint the yellow chip for this many days. They can still show when another rule that is not cooled down also matches. After that they match again. An exception phrase does not expire with the cool-down; undo that row to drop it.
en.vetoUndone: Undid that veto. Confirmed strikes were left as they are.
